name: roundtable
description: Multi-model consensus MCP server. Dispatches one prompt to the local Antigravity, Copilot, Codex, and Claude CLIs in parallel — and to any configured OpenAI-compatible HTTP providers (Kimi, MiniMax, GLM, DeepSeek, …) — then returns every response as structured JSON for synthesis. Bundles the roundtable MCP server (via .mcp.json) and the roundtable usage skill.
